mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% for three consecutive months signals persistent labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE has exceeded 8.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST and RSAFS both declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, as measured by Rank IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate capital expenditure and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate accelerating labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE rising and PAYEMS falling) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, as measured by Rank IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Near-zero interest rate policy (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) combined with persistent low inflation supports extended equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.
